updatedBy: window-from-the-chain 2026-10-21: curationWindowSeconds removed. run-hive-curation-cycle-service 0.2.0 reads the reverse auction window (HIVE_REVERSE_AUCTION_WINDOW_SECONDS_HF25) from condenser_api.get_config on every node and passes it to schedule-set-of-votes-service 0.3.0, which requires it; nothing reads it from this record. curationWindowToleranceSeconds stays: the schedule still reads it from the policy. Earlier: curation-window-correction 2026-09-26: curationWindowSeconds/curationWindowToleranceSeconds were modeling the PRE-HF25 five-minute reverse-auction (votes cast in a post's first 5 minutes lost curation reward). Hardfork 25 ('Equilibrium', 2021-06-30) removed the reverse auction entirely: 'the 5 minute reverse auction is going away, so there is no punishment for voting early' (hive.blog/hive/@hiveio/hive-hardfork-25-is-on-the-way). Under the current linear curve, curation reward within a post's first 24 hours is based solely on the curator's HP and vote weight -- there is no timing bonus or penalty in that window; the reward curve only softens after 24 hours to the end of the 7-day payout window (hive.blog/hive-167922/@ackza/qraneo; search-corroborated 2026-09-26). Gating candidates to age 240-360s therefore serves no protocol purpose and was measured live on cold-red-gate to refuse ~99% of candidates as 'outside-window' (1592 of ~1600 refusals across the 2026-09-05..09-26 journal, vs 11 real votes cast for michael561 in the last hour of chain history read via condenser_api.get_account_history). Corrected: curationWindowSeconds 300->0, curationWindowToleranceSeconds 60->150 (accept a post from the moment it is read up to 150s old) -- vote as early as candidate posts are seen, per current rules, while keeping the same narrow age-band width the original policy relied on to keep each post's candidacy alive for roughly one cycle only (no vote-history de-duplication exists yet in schedule-set-of-votes/cast-set-of-votes; widening the tolerance far beyond one cycle's span would let the same top-of-feed post re-qualify and be re-cast on repeatedly, which Hive's vote_evaluator rejects as an identical-vote error and which would waste RC every cycle -- named as follow-on work, not fixed by this policy edit).
